mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month cumulative rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, which precedes broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% monthly for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% monthly for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% quarterly) signals robust economic expansion that increases corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 0.3pp) and non-farm payrolls declines (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) indicate labor market weakening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% monthly for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% monthly for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending growth (RSAFS > 1.0% monthly) indicates robust economic activity that boosts corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% monthly.
